source.kind: manually curated extract of the official archived schema, not a full schema copy
source.limitation: The archive is not proof of the exact installed 7.4-20 package set. Verify installed schema and package versions before live acceptance.

fields.version: Full pve-manager package version of this node

endpoints.assertion: Record actual values; do not derive qemu-server or kernel versions from this response.
A free-ID query is not a reservation; a race may still cause clone conflict.

full.documented_behavior: Normal VM clones copy all disks; template clones attempt linked clones by default.

target.documented_behavior: Target node; only allowed if the original VM is on shared storage.

endpoints.assertion: Persist returned task reference; do not configure before clone completion.
Default response includes pending changes. Use current=1 and pending separately when reporting active configuration.
Successful synchronous null response is valid; a response lost after submission is still uncertain.
With background_delay, completion within the wait can return null; otherwise persist UPID. No synthetic UPID is allowed.

digest.documented_behavior: Reject if current configuration SHA1 digest differs.

sshkeys.documented_behavior: OpenSSH public keys, one key per line.

endpoints.assertion: Validate declared driver fields and encode SSH keys at the API value layer as required by the installed schema.
Pending configuration is not proof of an active runtime change.
Task submission is not task completion; stop is forceful, not graceful shutdown.
Graceful stop must not enable forceStop or fall back to stop after timeout.
No forceStop parameter is declared here. Do not translate reboot to reset, stop/start, or start of a stopped VM.

purge.documented_behavior: Remove VMID references from configurations such as backup, replication and HA.

destroy-unreferenced-disks.documented_behavior: Also delete unreferenced disks with a matching VMID from enabled storages.

endpoints.assertion: Do not add shutdown, unlock, purge or extra disk deletion implicitly. Deletion already removes used/owned volumes and VM-specific permissions/firewall rules.
Stopped alone is not success. Task lookup failure does not prove VM absence. Live evidence must confirm successful tasks have exitstatus OK.
Capture bounded sanitized log evidence; retain task node separately from the VM's mutable locator.
